title: FPRAS for common integer polymatroid bases
exact_target: Given value oracles for two integer polymatroid rank functions on n elements with binary-encoded capacities and compatible base totals, can one estimate the number of common nonnegative integral base vectors within relative error $\varepsilon $ and failure $\delta $ using polynomially many oracle calls and bit operations in n, total encoding length, $\varepsilon ^{-1}$ and $\log (\delta ^{-1})$, including a certain zero answer for emptiness?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
